title: Session store that exposes only what callers need
task: Build `session.Store` in package `session` with `Start(user string) ID`, `User(id ID) (string, error)`, `Touch(id ID) error` which refreshes the session's activity, and `Expire()` which removes sessions idle for more than thirty minutes; the clock is given at construction. Safe for concurrent use. Expose only what a caller needs and nothing about how sessions are kept.
